 HARRISBURG — The Pennsylvania Department of Aging has launched a new toll-free hotline for Medicare beneficiaries to report suspected fraud, errors and abuse during the annual Medicare open enrollment period.
 The hotline, 877-435-7014, is available Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Services are free and confidential.
